title: 경로 A bounded policy 학습

schema_change.rationale: bounded IR, candidate search, and validation handoff are pure functions over sealed artifacts; persistence reuses existing ledgers when wired

verification.ruff: 0 findings in WP15-owned paths under cyrano/configs/quality/ruff.toml
verification.formatter: ruff format --check clean on WP15-owned paths
verification.dev_check: dev.py check exit 0 after docs regeneration
verification.quality_gate: 0 findings in WP15-owned paths; pre-existing baseline debt unchanged

architecture.policy_ir: validate_ir compiles a bounded rule list over whitelisted features; loop/while -> UNBOUNDED_LOOP, import -> IMPORT_FORBIDDEN, unknown feature/action/op -> refused, literals outside the bound -> BOUND_REQUIRED, non-string kind -> IR_SHAPE
architecture.search: generate_policy_candidate compiles any valid combination as a new policy (novel flag vs profile menu, never menu-limited); screen_replay scores only observations at or before the cutoff and counts excluded future data; zero support is score=None, not 0
architecture.policy_runner: request_actual_validation binds the screened IR digest into a sealed EvaluationManifest under one ExecutionSignature; decide_activation requires signature match + actual improved verdict + independent review + bounded approval; replay score alone is never sufficient

review_findings_resolved: node kind of a non-hashable type raised TypeError instead of IR_SHAPE
not_established: search_optimization (generation compiles the supplied spec; enumeration strategies are out of scope)
